BT25-078.effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with [Three Musketeers] in its text to the hand, or you may place 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
